headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery submits investor presentation to exchange
hook: PNGS Reva files latest investor presentation
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited has informed stock exchanges about its latest investor presentation. The filing contains operational and corporate updates for shareholders and prospective investors. Such disclosures are routine regulatory requirements under listing guidelines.
why_it_matters: Provides operational context for existing and prospective shareholders.

headline: PNGS Reva submits missing September 2026 financial statements
summary: PNGS Reva has submitted its Statement of Assets and Liabilities and Cash Flow statement as of September 30, 2026. These documents were omitted from the company's earlier Board Meeting outcome filing. The submission corrects the regulatory disclosure record for the listed entity. Indian retail investors tracking the company's financial health now have access to the complete half-yearly data.
why_it_matters: Compliance record corrected with delayed financial data release

headline: PNGS Reva Q2 profit jumps 78% as stock price drops
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery reported a 78% increase in net profit for the second quarter, supported by strong festive season sales. Despite the positive financial performance, the company's shares fell more than 13% on the NSE. The sharp decline suggests market participants may have priced in the growth or reacted to other underlying factors not captured in the headline profit figure.
why_it_matters: Strong earnings failed to prevent a sharp sell-off in shares.

headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery reports 35% sales growth
hook: Strong festive demand for diamond retailer
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery recorded sales of ₹38.53 crore during the Navratri-Dussehra period, marking a 35.01% year-on-year increase. The company also expanded its physical footprint by opening a new store in Jaipur. This growth reflects a positive trend in consumer spending on certified natural diamond jewellery during the festive season.
why_it_matters: Signals robust festive consumer demand for luxury jewellery retailers.
winners_losers: PNGS Reva gains / Jewellery peers potentially benefit

headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery reports 62% sales growth during Dussehra
hook: Strong festive demand boosts jewellery retailer
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery recorded a 62% year-on-year increase in sales during the Dussehra festival period. Alongside the sales growth, the company expanded its retail footprint by opening a new store in Jaipur. This performance reflects robust consumer spending trends in the Indian jewellery sector during the festive season.
why_it_matters: Signals strong consumer demand for jewellery during the festive season.

headline: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery shares surge 35% in two days to hit a new high of ₹738.40
summary: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery share price reached a new high of ₹738.40 in Thursday's trading session. The stock has surged 35 per cent over the past two days. It has also gained 125 per cent from its 52-week low of ₹328 recorded on March 30, 2026. Retail investors tracking jewellery stocks should note the sharp upward momentum in this counter.
why_it_matters: Sharp rally in small-cap jewellery stock draws momentum traders.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / new buyers face volatility
